verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's own marketing page directly claims a performance mode that boosts hardware speed on demand, which matches the core of the story. That claim is only a single line of marketing copy, and no community or hands-on report addresses it. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the toggle mechanism and its behavior (e.g., which power profiles exist, which hardware is supported, what it actually changes), independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can boost hardware performance on demand using a performance mode toggle

citations.quote: Use performance mode to boost hardware speed when you need it.
